'''SolSeed: Pick a Future''' is a six-minute music video created by [[Ben]].  It is not currently available online, as we want to get proper permission to use the music before distributing it.  The main music track is "Down to Earth" by Peter Gabriel, which played over the credits of the movie WALL-E.  We also want to use the last verse of "After the Gold Rush" by Neil Young.

Music starts. My narration:<br>
“There are two ways we could emigrate from Earth. <br>
A few of us could flee as refugees, <br>
from a home that we <br>
accidentally set on fire.<br> 
Or, many of us could go out across the stars <br>
as gardeners, serving our Mother Earth <br>
by planting and growing new living worlds. <br>
But first, <br>
we would need to come back down to Earth, <br>
put out the fires, <br>
and reconnect with the living world <br>
that gave us birth.” <br>
<br>
